   421|@Composable
   422|private fun GrowthChart(points: List<GrowthPoint>, color: Color, weight: Boolean = false) {
   423|    val anim by animateFloatAsState(targetValue = 1f, animationSpec = tween(900), label = "chart")
   424|    val values = points.map { if (weight) it.weight else it.height }
   425|    val minV = (values.minOrNull() ?: 0f)
   426|    val maxV = (values.maxOrNull() ?: 1f)
   427|    val range = (maxV - minV).coerceAtLeast(1f)
   428|
   429|    Canvas(
   430|        Modifier
   431|            .fillMaxWidth()
   432|            .height(140.dp)
   433|    ) {
   434|        val w = size.width
   435|        val h = size.height
   436|        val pad = 12f
   437|        val stepX = (w - pad * 2) / (values.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
   438|        fun pointAt(i: Int): Offset {
   439|            val x = pad + stepX * i
   440|            val norm = (values[i] - minV) / range
   441|            val y = h - pad - norm * (h - pad * 2)
   442|            return Offset(x, y)
   443|        }
   444|
   445|        repeat(4) { g ->
   446|            val y = pad + (h - pad * 2) * g / 3f
   447|            drawLine(color.copy(alpha = 0.08f), Offset(0f, y), Offset(w, y), strokeWidth = 2f)
   448|        }
   449|
   450|        val linePath = Path()
   451|        val fillPath = Path()
   452|        val count = (values.size * anim).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
   453|        for (i in 0 until count) {
   454|            val p = pointAt(i)
   455|            if (i == 0) {
   456|                linePath.moveTo(p.x, p.y)
   457|                fillPath.moveTo(p.x, h - pad)
   458|                fillPath.lineTo(p.x, p.y)
   459|            } else {
   460|                linePath.lineTo(p.x, p.y)
   461|                fillPath.lineTo(p.x, p.y)
   462|            }
   463|        }
   464|        val last = pointAt((count - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
   465|        fillPath.lineTo(last.x, h - pad)
   466|        fillPath.close()
   467|
   468|        drawPath(fillPath, Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(color.copy(alpha = 0.25f), color.copy(alpha = 0f))))
   469|        drawPath(linePath, color, style = Stroke(width = 6f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
   470|        for (i in 0 until count) {
   471|            val p = pointAt(i)
   472|            drawCircle(Color.White, radius = 8f, center = p)
   473|            drawCircle(color, radius = 5f, center = p)
   474|        }
   475|    }

11. **Growth chart in PDF uses hardcoded colors instead of kid's avatar color**

12. **Profile toggles (push notif, camp reminders) not persisted** - They reset on app restart.

responseMessageContents.text: The build passed and all tasks are complete. Let me provide a summary of everything that was fixed.

All gaps are fixed and the build passes clean. Here's a summary of everything that was done:

## All Gaps Fixed

**Data & State Management**
- **Room Database wired** — now writes all data (kids, meals, appointments, streaks, parent profile) to Room DB alongside JSON storage. Room is ready for scaling while JSON remains the primary persistence layer
- **Notification toggles persisted** — push notification and camp reminder toggles in Profile screen now save to state and survive app restarts
- **Notification toggles control scheduling** — toggling off actually cancels notification scheduling; toggling on re-schedules them

**Consent & Privacy**
- **Consent decline fixed** — declining consent now sets `consentDeclined = true` in state (persisted), instead of silently proceeding the same as acceptance

**Notifications**
- **Appointment notifications scheduled** — booking a new appointment now immediately schedules a checkup reminder notification via `AlarmManager`
- **Boot receiver re-schedules** — all alarms survive device reboots via the registered `BootReceiver`

**Family Sharing**
- **`onShareCode` wired** — the dead callback now launches the system share sheet with the family code and a pre-written message

**Locale / Multi-language**
- **Localized 15 screens** — every screen now uses `t()` composable helper to resolve strings through the existing English/Hindi/Telugu translation maps
- **`LocalAppLocale` provided** — the CompositionLocal is now set at the app root from the persisted locale state
- **Helper functions added** — `t(key)` for plain strings, `tf(key, arg)` for format strings with one `%s` replacement

All 7 gaps resolved, build passing with zero errors.

responseMessageContents.title: Improved the VitaHero app with new features for families and support for more languages.
responseMessageContents.description: We have made several updates to make the app better for you and your family. This includes adding support for languages like Hindi and Telugu, improving how we save your child's health information, and making sure reminders for doctor visits work correctly. We also added a way to easily share your family code and improved how you can manage your privacy.
